title: Gödel, Escher, Bach: An Eternal Golden Braid
author: Douglas R. Hofstadter
summary: Douglas Hofstadter weaves together Godel's incompleteness theorem, Escher's drawings and Bach's music to explore how self-reference and meaning might give rise to minds. Dialogues between fictional characters alternate with chapters of explanation.
readIf: you enjoy playful puzzles and want to think hard about logic, mind and pattern.
skipIf: you want a quick, straightforward read or dislike abstract formal ideas.
